tei:div.tei:p: (cha)༄༅// bcom ldan 'das dam tshig rdo rje'i sgom bzlas sbyin sreg dang bcas pa'i skor rnams bzhugs so// ༄༅// oṃ swa sti sid+dhaṃ/ bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la spyi bos gus pas phyag 'tshal lo// de la rdo rje theg pa'i rtsa ba dang yan lag gi ltung ba las ldang ba la gsum ste/ stobs bzhi'i sgo nas sdig pa bshags pa dang*/ bla ma brgyud pa'i man ngag gis sbyar ba dam tshig rdo rje bsnyen sgrub yan lag bzhi'i sgo nas sdig pa bshags pa dang*/ tshul gzhan gyi sgo nas sdig pa bshags pa'o// dang po rten gyi stobs ni yul bla ma nyid dam/ bla ma de dang yul 'gyangs ma ring la sogs par gyur te ma phrad na sdom pa dang ldan pa'i rdo rje spun grogs so// rnam par sun 'byin pa'i stobs ni sngar byas pa'i nyes pa la shin tu 'gyod cing bshungs pa'o// gnyen po kun tu spyod pa'i stobs ni phyin chad 'di lta bu srog gi phyir yang mi byed do snyam pa'i dam bca' ba brtan po 'cha' ba'o// de lta bu'i bsam pa dang ldan pas rten gyi spyan snga'am/ bla ma'am/ rdo rje spun gyi drung du maṇ+ḍal bya ba'am/ med kyang rung ste bla ma'am spun grogs rgan pa la phyag bya zhing*/ rang bas gzhon pa la ni phyag bya mi dgos pas thal mo sbyar nas tsog tsog por 'dug ste 'di skad du/ bla ma'am rdo rje spun grogs bdag la dgongs su gsol/ bdag rig pa 'dzin pa ming 'di zhes bya ba la ji skad du bshad pa'i nyes pa 'di lta bu zhig byung lags na/ de khyed kyi spyan snga'am/ drung du mthol zhing 'chags lags so// mthol zhing bshags na ni bdag bde ba la reg par gnas par 'gyur gyi/ ma mthol ma bshags na ni de ltar mi 'gyur ba lags so zhes lan gsum du brjod de/ rten gyis smras pa/ rig pa 'dzin pa khyod kyis nyes pa la nyes par mthong ngam/ 'chags pa pos smras pa/ mthong lags so// rten gyis smras pa/ slan chad kyang sdom mam/

'chags pa pos smras pa/ rdo rje 'chang gi bka' bzhin legs par gsungs pa spyi bos len cing slan chad sdom lags so// rten gyis smras pa/ 'di sdig pa zad par byed pa'i thabs yin no// 'chags pa pos smras pa/ de ni legs lags so zhes brjod la phyag bya'am/ gzhon pa yin na phyag mi dgos te ldang bar bya'o// bzhi pa sor chud pa'i stobs ni/ thabs de lta bus bdag gi sdig pa thams cad dag go snyam du dga' ba bsgom pa yin no// 'dis ni nyes pa phra mo thams cad sor chud par 'gyur ba yin no// rang gi blos phye ste nyes pa cung zad lci bar rtogs na bshags pa snga ma'i steng du gnyis pa dam tshig rdo rje bsnyen sgrub yan lag bzhi'i sgo nas sdig pa bshags pa ni/ rang yi dam gyi lhar gsal ba'i spyi bor pad+ma dang zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du kham̐ las ral gri kham̐ gis mtshan pa spros bsdus gcig tu gyur pa las/ bcom ldan 'das dam tshig rdo rje sku mdog ljang gu zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas ral gri/ g.yon des yu ba byas pa'i dril bu 'dzin pa/ rdo rje skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ yum dam tshig sgrol ma sku mdog ljang gu gri gug dang thod pa bsnams pas yab la 'khyud pa'i tshul du bzhugs pa'o// gnyis ka'ang cung zad 'dzum zhing yid tsam khro ba ral pa'i thor tshugs can/ rus pa dang rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ dar gyi sham thabs grol ba/ zla ba la rgyab brten pa bsam ste/ yan lag dang po bsnyen pa'i yan lag go /gnyis ka'i dpral bar oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ thugs ka'i stod du hūm̐ nag po/ thugs kyi nang du kham̐ las ral gri kham̐ gis mtshan pa ljang gu de rnams kyi'ang gdan ni zla ba'i dkyil 'khor te/ gnyis pa nye bar sgrub pa'i yan lag go /de'i thugs ka'i kham̐ las 'od zer 'phros te phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad spyan drangs nas/ dam tshig rdo rje'i rnam par byas te bstim pa ni gsum pa bsgrub pa'i yan lag go

/de gnyis kyi spyi bor don yod grub pa dbu rgyan rang chas su bsgom pa ni bzhi pa sgrub pa chen po'i yan lag go /de nas thugs ka'i kham̐ las ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun kha dog dkar po'i rnam par babs nas/ bcom ldan 'das yab yum gyi sku thams cad khengs te sku las bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun bdag gi spyi bo'i gtsug na mar babs pas/ spyir las kyi sgrib pa thams cad dang*/ bye brag tu gang nyes pa byas pa thams cad kha dog tu grub pa med kyang rnal 'byor pa'i blo sbyang ba'i phyir nag po'i rnam pa rnams ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i chus ded nas/ 'og sgo gnyis dang rkang mthil nas 'thon nas lus thams cad dkar mer gyis khengs par bsam zhing*/ oṃ āḥkham̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ zhes lan mang du bzlas la/ thun 'jog khar yab yum gnyis ka spyi bo na mar thim ste sdig pa thams cad dag nas bdag gi rgyud byin gyis brlabs par bsam mo// de lta bu'i grangs kyi nges pa bdun 'bum la sogs pa'i grangs sam/ dus kyi nges pa zla ba drug gam/ mtshan ma'i nges pa lus las ngan skyugs 'thon pa'am/ gos dkar po gyon pa'am/ khrus byas pa'am/ nam mkha' la 'gro ba la sogs pa'i rmi ltas bzang po byung gi bar la bya'o// de lta bu'i tshul gyis bzlas sgom yun ring du byas kyang sgrib pa dag pa'i mtshan ma ma byung na de'i steng du'ang gsum pa tshul gzhan gyi sgo nas sdig pa bshags par bya ste/ sngar gyi de'i steng du brtson 'grus dang brtul ba mchog tu gyur pas rim pa gnyis thun bzhi la sogs par bsgom pa dang*/ bzhi 'bum la sogs pa'i grangs kyi bsnyen pa bya ba dang*/ bsnyen pa'i bcu cha la sogs pas zhi ba'i sbyin sreg bya ba dang*/ dam tshig dang sdom pa dang ldan pa'i grogs tshangs par mtshungs par spyod pa mang du bsags te/ tshogs kyi 'khor lo bya ba'i tshul gyis skong ba ni gtso bo ste/ thun mtshams rnams su mdo bklag pa dang*/

sāts+tsha gdab pa dang*/ bskor ba bya ba dang*/ gtor ma gtang ba dang*/ srog chags kyi tshe bskyab pa la sogs pa'i tshul gyis kyang yin no// tshul gzhan gyi sgo nas sdig pa bshags pa 'di ni dran bas ma zin te/ dam tshig gi nyes pa ma tshor bar byung ba dag dang*/ tshe thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i las kyi sgrib pa sbyang ba dang*/ sa dang lam gyi rim pa rnams bgrod par bya ba'i phyir rgyun du'ang nyams su blang ba yin no// ltung ba las ldang ba bstan zin to// zhes rje btsun rin po che grags pa rgyal mtshan gyis mdzad pa'i rtsa ba'i ltung ba bcu bzhi pa'i 'grel pa gsal byed 'khrul spong las khol du phyung ba'o// maṅga laṃ// ༈ /dam tshig rdo rje'i sgrub thabs sdig sgrib kun 'joms bzhugs so// na mo gu ru bh+yaḥ bla ma rje btsun mchog la phyag btsal nas// yang snying rdo rje theg pa'i rnal 'byor pas// dam tshig nyams chag bskang zhing bshags pa'i phyir// dam tshig rdo rje'i bzlas sgom bri bar bya// de la 'dir rdo rje theg pa'i rnal 'byor pa rnams kyis dbang dus su thob pa'i rtsa ba dang yan lag gi dam tshig nyams chag bskang ba'i phyir/ dam tshig rdo rje'i bzlas sgom bya ba la don gsum ste/ sbyor dngos rjes so// de la dang po sbyor ba ni/ rang nyid dges pa rdo rje la sogs pa thun mtshams kyi he ru ka'i nga rgyal dang ldan pas/ stan bde ba la bsam gtan gyi spyod lam gyis 'dug la/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed ni/ sangs rgyas chos tshogs tshar gsum dang*/ tshad med bzhi bsgom pa ni sbyor ba'o// dngos gzhi ni/ rang he ru kar gsal ba'i spyi bor pad+ma dang zla ba'i gdan la kham̐ las ral gri kham̐ gis mtshan pa de las 'od zer 'phros/ don gnyis byas/ tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las skad cig gis bcom ldan 'das dam tshig rdo rje sku mdog ljang gu zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas ral gri 'phyar zhing*/ g.yon des yu ba byas pa'i dril bu dkur brten pa/

zhabs rdo rje'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/ de'i pang na yum dam tshig sgrol ma ljang gu gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa dang mnyam par sbyor ba/ gnyis ka'ang cung zad 'dzum zhing khro ba/ rus pa dang rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ dar gyi sham thabs can/ zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la rgyab brten pa/ de gnyis ka'i dpral bar oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ thugs ka'i stod du hūm̐ sngon po/ thugs ka'i nang du zla ba la gnas pa'i kham̐ las ral gri kham̐ ljang gus mtshan pa/ de las 'od zer 'phros pas phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad dam tshig rdo rje yab yum gyi rnam par oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ gnyis su med par thim/ de gnyis kyi spyi bor don yod grub pa'i dbu rgyan rang chas su bzhugs par gyur/ de'i thugs ka'i kham̐ las ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun kha dog dkar po'i rnam par babs/ yab kyi sku gang*/ dbyibs brgyud yum gyis sku gang*/ yab yum gnyis kyi sku thams cad las bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs pas bdag gi spyi bo nas zhugs pas tshe 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i las ngan spyi dang*/ khyad par rtsa ba dang yan lag gi dam tshig dang sdom pa'i tshogs la nyes ltung gi dri mas gos pa thams cad dud khu'i rnam pas bshang gci gnyis dang rkang mthil gnyis nas thon/ shul thams cad bdud rtsi dkar pos khengs par gyur/ oṃ āḥkham̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ zhes brgya stong la sogs pa ci nus bzlas pa'i mthar/ phreng ba thal mo'i bar du bcug ste/ bla ma bdag ni mi shes rmongs pa ste// dam tshig las ni 'gal zhing nyams// bla ma mgon pos skyabs mdzod cig /gtso bo rdo rje 'dzin pa ste// thugs rje chen po'i bdag nyid can// 'gro ba'i gtso la bdag skyabs mchi// sku gsung thugs rtsa ba dang yan lag gi dam tshig nyams pa thams cad mthol lo bshags so// sdig sgrib nyes ltung dri ma'i tshogs thams cad byang zhing dag par mdzad du gsol/

zhes gsol ba btab pas dam tshig rdo rje yab yum 'od du zhu/ spyi bo nas rang la thim pas rang gi lus shel gong g.ya' dag pa lta bur gyur/ ces brjod pa ni dngos gzhi'o// rjes kyi bya ba ni/ dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag /dam tshig rdo rje 'grub gyur nas// 'gro ba gcig kyang ma lus pa// de yi sa la 'god par shog /dam tshig rdo rje khyed sku ci 'dra dang*// sogs sh+lo ka gcig brjod/ khyed la mchod cing gsol ba btab pa'i mthus// rnal 'byor bdag cag mi shes gti mug pas// dam tshig sdom pa nyams chag ci mchis pa// byang zhing dag nas sangs rgyas sa thob shog /rgyal ba kun gyi phrin las bye ba'i gter// margad mdangs ldan lha mchog yab yum gyi// thugs rje'i stobs kyis sdig sgrib kun byang nas// kha sbyor bdun ldan thob pa'i bkra shis shog /ces brjod pa ni rjes kyi bya ba'o// de lta bu'i sgo nas bsnyen pa sogs bya bar 'dod na/ zhag bdun nam nyi shu rtsa gcig gam zla ba gcig la sogs pa ji ltar rigs par thun bzhi'i sgo nas bzhi 'bum mam bdun 'bum la sogs pa mtshan ma ma thob kyi bar du bsnyen pa bya zhing*/ mtshan ma'i rtags su rmi lam du lus las ngan skyugs 'thon pa/ gos dkar po gyon pa/ khrus byas pa/ nam mkha' la 'phur ba sogs dang*/ dngos su'ang shes pa dwangs shing dge sbyor la blo 'dun pa dang*/ yi dam lha'i zhal mthong ba/ sgrub khang la dri bzang chags pa/ shes rgyud la byang chub kyi sems skye ba sogs rtags nges can thob pa'i gang zag gis bsnyen mtshams grol nas bcu cha'i sbyin sreg la sogs pa tshul bzhin du bgyid pa dang*/ bsnyen pa'i skabs rnams su'ang thun mtshams thams cad du mdo klog pa dang*/ sāts+tsha gdab pa dang*/ gtor ma gtong ba dang*/ bskor ba bya ba dang*/ srog chags 'tshe ba las bskyab pa sogs dge ba'i bya ba kho nas dus 'da' ba gal che zhing*/ tshul de ltar nyams su blangs na skye ba dpag tu med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig sgrib dang*/

khyad par dam tshig dang sdom pa'i tshogs la nyams chag ci mchis pa byang zhing dag nas sa lam myur du bgrod pa'i gegs sel bogs 'don gyi mchog dam par 'gyur ba bla ma gong ma rnams kyi gsung las 'byung ba ltar don la'ang de ltar grub pa lags so// zhes pa 'di yang rang gi nye gnas bsod nams 'od zer gyis rgyun gyi kha 'don du dam tshig rdo rje'i sgom bzlas zhig dgos zhes bskul ba'i ngor/ sa skya pa ngag dbang kun dga' blo gros kyis mgyogs par sbyar ba dge legs 'phel// sarba dā maṅga laṃ// ༈ /bcom ldan 'das dam tshig rdo rje'i sbyin sreg gi cho ga 'od gsal rdo rje'i me long zhes bya ba bzhugs so// na mo gu ru sa ma ya badz+ra pā dā bh+yāṃ/ 'da' dka'i dam tshig 'od gsal rdo rje'i khams// snying pos lci ba'i

gu ru ste bla ma rin chen za ma tog /spyi bo'i rgyan du blangs te nyes ltung tshogs// byin zar stob pa'i cho ga rnam par dbye// rnal 'byor chen po'i thabs lam la zhugs pa dag gis thun mtshams su dam tshig gi nyes pa sbyang ba'i don du sbyin sreg byed par 'dod na/ sbyor dngos rjes gsum gyis rtogs par bya ste/ dang po ni/ rnam par dul ba'i gnas su zhi ba'i thab thig spyi dang mthun par gdab/ gzhi tshon dkar po la thab nang du pad+ma 'dab brgyad/ mu ran la rdo rje'i phreng ba/ stegs bu'i grwa bzhir zla phyed rdo rje'i rtse nang bstan sogs mdzes tshon gyis dbye/ pad+ma'i lte bar ral gri ljang gu'am/ tshon phung tsam dgod/ rang nyid kha shar du phyogs pa'i g.yas su/ yam shing*/ mar/ til nag ste rdzas kyi gtso bo gsum dang*/ g.yon phyogs su gtor ma gnyis/ chu gnyis sngon 'gro'i nyer spyod tshan gnyis bsham/ mdun du rdo rje dril bu'i bar du dgang blugs kha sbyar ba/ g.yas su dri bzang gi bsang chu 'thor yab bcas dang*/ g.yon du nang gi mchod pa bsham/ ku sha'i chun po brgyad/ bud shing dang*/ me dang me yol chas dang 'dug stangs sogs zhi ba'i sbyin sreg spyi dang 'dra/ gnyis pa dngos gzhi la/ bdag bskyed ni kye rdor ram/ bde mchog gam/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma sogs bla med kyi yi dam rang gang la gtso bor byed pa de'i sgom bzlas nyams su blangs pa'i mthar/ dam tshig rdo rje'i sgom bzlas rje btsun grol mchog gi khrid brgya'i dbu nas 'byung ba ltar ram/ ngag dbang kun blo'i yig cha bzhin sbrel na legs shing*/ ma sbrel na'ang 'gal ba cher med/ gang ltar yang dpal 'bar lag pa gnyis kas gus pa'i tshul gyis thab la g.yas nas zlum por bskor zhing ngag tu/ oṃ dz+wa la dz+wa la ram̐/ de nas khu tshur gnyis bcangs pa'i mthe bong brkyang ba byang chub mchog gi phyag rgyas dgang blugs bzung la/ blugs gzar mar dang bcas pas dgang gzar gyi kha la reg cing bud shing la khyab par blugs te/

oṃ dz+wa la dz+wa la ram̐ zhes brjod/ bsang chu la dmigs te oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta sogs bdag bskyed gang yin gyi las sngags tshar kha yar brjod pas/ rdzas rnams kyi ma dag pa sel ba'i nus pa dang ldan par bsam/ las sngags gang yin pa de brjod cing thab dang yo byad thams cad la bsang gtor bya/ bsreg rdzas dang mchod rdzas rnams swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las a las byung ba'i ye shes kyi ka pā la yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du hūm̐ zhu ba las byung ba'i lha rdzas las grub pa'i bsreg rdzas dang mchod rdzas rnams dwangs shing thogs pa med pa lha mnyes pa dang*/ so so'i las sgrub pa'i nus pa dang ldan par gyur/ ces dang*/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ lan gsum la sogs pas rdzas rnams dang*/ oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ āḥhūm̐/ oṃ badz+ra pā d+yaṃ āḥhūm̐ sogs nas shab+da āḥhūm̐ gi bar gyis mchod pa rnams byin gyis brlab/ thab swa bhā was stong par sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las pam̐ las pad+ma dang ram̐ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ las byung ba'i zhi ba'i thab khung dkar po zlum po yangs shing rgya che ba dwangs shing thogs pa med pa/ mu ran la rdo rje'i phreng bas brgyan pa/ phyi rol tu stegs bu gru bzhi pa'i zur bzhir zla phyed rdo rjes mtshan pa bris pa dang gnyis su med par gyur/ me 'bar ba'i dbus su pam̐ las pad+ma dang ram̐ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du ram̐ las bgrang phreng ram̐ gyis mtshan pa las 'od 'phros 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ me lha ra skyes la zhon pa zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas bgrang phreng dang*/ g.yon spyi blugs 'dzin pa/ lus po me'i rang bzhin dmar po zhal gyi dkyil 'khor dkar po las 'od zer dkar po 'phro ba/ gsus khyim che ba ral pa'i thor tshugs can ag tshom 'phyang ba drang srong gi tshogs kyis bskor ba/ de'i dpral bar oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ thugs kar hūm̐ sngon po/

rang gi snying ga'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas shar lho nas me lha drang srong gi tshogs kyis bskor ba oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ zhes dang*/ lag pa gnyis kyi mthe bong gung mo'i rtsa bar bzhag mdzub mos gung mo'i rgyab nas bkab pa dbyu gu rtse gsum pa'i phyag rgya rna ba'i drung du g.yab cing*/ tshur spyon tshur spyon 'byung po che// me lha'i rgyal po drang srong mchog /bsreg blugs zhal zas bzhes slad du// 'di nyid du ni gshegs su gsol// oṃ ag+na ye ma hā te dzaḥsarba karma pra sā dha ka ma hā bhū ta de wa ri ṣi dwi dza sat+ta ma/ gri hī twā ā hu tiṃ ā ha ra/ asmin san+ni hi to bha wa/ zhes pas spyan drangs/ oṃ pad+ma ka ma lā ya s+t+waṃ zhes brjod la/ thab tu me tog dor te/ thab kyi shar lhor pad+ma'i gdan la bzhugs par bsam/ oṃ ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ oṃ pā d+yaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ zhes pas chu gnyis dbul/ rdo rje rtse lnga pa'i phyag rgya bcas la/ oṃ badz+ra a na la ma hā bhū ta dz+wā lā ya sarba bhasmī ku ru sarba duṣ+ṭān hūm̐ phaṭ dṛ sh+ya dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥs ma ya s+t+waṃ/ zhes dang*/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥs bstim/ slar yang rang gi snying ga'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis 'di la mngon par dbang bskur ba stsal du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyis bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ sku gang*/ dri ma dag chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las rnam par snang mdzad kyis dbur brgyan par bsam/ de nas/ oṃ ag+na ye sa pa ri wā ra zhes re re'i sngon du 'gro bas oṃ ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ pā d+yaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūm̐ sogs nas shab+da āḥhūm̐ bar dang*/ oṃ badz+ra ghaṇ+ḍe ra ṇi sogs brjod/ oṃ ag+na ye sa pa ri wā ra oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis nang mchod dbul/

rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas/ 'jig rten dbang phyug tshangs dbang mgon gyis sras// me lha'i rgyal po ḍā kis dbang bskur ba// shes rab mchog gis nyon mongs thams cad sreg /'dzin byed me lha nyid la rnam par 'dud// ces pas bstod/ ku sha'i chun po brgyad bsang sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las hūm̐ las byung ba'i ku sha sngo ljang rtsa ba dang rtse mo ma nyams pa dwangs shing thogs pa med pa thab dang yo byad rnams kyi 'bags pa dang ma dag pa thams cad sel ba'i nus pa dang ldan par gyur/ ces dang*/ oṃ/ ku sha 'di ni bzang zhing dge /sa las skyes pa'i snying po mchog /tshangs pa yi ni dag byed yin// dkon mchog gsum gyi dag byed de// des bdag la gegs med cing zhi bar mdzod cig /ces pa'i mthar oṃ badz+ra satwa āḥzhes brjod de thab kyi mdun nas g.yas skor gyi rim pas phyogs mtshams brgyad du rtse mo g.yas bskor du dgram mo// dgang blugs byang chub mchog gi phyag rgyas bzung ste/ me lha'i zhal cung zad gdangs pa'i ljags hūm̐ las rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan pa la ram̐ dang*/ dgang blugs kyi gzar bu'i kha la'ang ram̐ bsams te/ oṃ ag+na ye swā hā zhes lan bdun brjod cing mar khu blugs gzar bdun gyis dgang gzar bkang la mthar/ oṃ ag+na ye ā dī pyā dī pya ma hā shrī ye ha bya ka bya bā ha nā ya swā hā/ zhes brjod de gzar bu gnyis kha sbyar la me lha'i zhal du phul bar bsam mo// de lta bu lan gsum gyis byon zan phul la bar der me'i pra brtags te ngan na hūm̐ zhes brjod cing bsang chu 'thor ro// de nas yam shing lag pa g.yon du bzung*/ g.yas pa'i mtheb srin gyis steng nas blangs te mchog sbyin gyi phyag rgyas dbul zhing byang chub kyi shing du mos te/ oṃ bo dhi bṛk+ṣā ya swā hā/ zhes pas bdun nam ci 'byor phul ba'i mthar/ oṃ bo dhi bṛk+ṣā bdag gi tshe 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig pa dang sgrib pa bag chags dang bcas pa thams cad dang*/

dam tshig dang sdom pa'i nyes ltung dri ma'i tshogs thams cad shīn+taṃ ku ru swā hā/ de bzhin du grangs dang spel tshig 'dra bas/ oṃ ag+na ye swā hā/ zhes pas mar dang*/ oṃ sarba pā paṃ da ha na badz+rā ya swā hā/ zhes pas til dbul/ slar yang gong ltar mchod bstod byas la mar blugs gzar gang thab tu blugs te/ oṃ badz+ra dz+wa la ram̐ zhes brjod pas me lha 'bar ba'i rnam par bsam pa yan chad ni 'jig rten pa'i me lha mchod pa'i cho ga'o// de nas me 'bar ba'i dbus su pam̐ las pad+ma dang a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du kham̐ las ral gri kham̐ gis mtshan pa/ de las 'od zer 'phros 'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi don byas/ tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las bcom ldan 'das dam tshig rdo rje sku mdog margad ltar ljang ba zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas ral gri dang*/ g.yon des yu ba byas pa'i dril bu 'dzin pas yum la 'khyud pa/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs shing zla ba la rgyab brten pa/ de'i pang na yum dam tshig sgrol ma ljang gu gri gug dang thod pa 'dzin pa/ pad+ma'i 'dug stangs kyis yab dang mnyam par sbyor ba/ gnyis ka'ang 'dzum zhing yid tsam khro ba/ spyan gsum dang ldan zhing ral pa'i thor tshugs can/ dar gyi sham thabs grol ba/ rus pa dang rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ de'i dpral bar oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ thugs ka'i stod du hūm̐ sngon po dang*/ dbus su zla ba la gnas pa'i ral gri ljang gu kham̐ gis mtshan pa/ rang gi snying ga'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad bcom ldan 'das dam tshig rdo rje yab yum gyi rnam par oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ zhes dang rdo rje bsdu ba'i phyag rgya bya/ spos dang bcas pa'i rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas/ dmigs med mkha' ltar dag cing khyab pa yi// chos sku nam mkha' lta bur dbyer med kyang*// thabs dang shes rab gzugs brnyan skur ston pa'i// bcom ldan 'khor bcas 'dir ni gshegs su gsol// zhes dang*/

spro na/ ma lus sems can kun gyi mgon gyur cing*// zhes sogs sh+lo ka gcig gam gsum gyi mthar/ oṃ e h+ye bha ga wān sa ma ya añtsa mā nāṃ/ ar+ghaṃ pā d+yaṃ pra tīts+tsha pū dza no pa tsar+ya pra sid+dhim+me zhes brjod/ oṃ bha ga wān ma hā kā ru ṇi ka sa ma ya badz+ra sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā nas/ shab+da'i bar gyis mchod/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥs bstim/ slar yang thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ oṃ pañtsa ku la sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā nas/ shab+da pra tīts+tsha swā hā'i bar gyis mchod/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis 'di la mngon par dbang bskur ba stsal du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ de rnams kyis/ oṃ badz+rī bha wa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐ zhes gsung zhing bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur/ sku gang dri ma dag chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las rang 'dra'i don yod grub pas dbur brgyan/ zhes pa'am zhi ba'i sbyin sreg spyi 'gre bzhin rnam snang byas kyang rung*/ lha de nyid 'dzum zhing zhi ba 'od zer dkar po 'phro ba dang sdud pa'i sgo nas bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib thams cad zhi ba'i las mdzad par gyur/ slar yang hūm̐ zhes brjod cing bsang chu thab dang yo byad thams cad la gtor te mi gtsang ba dang nyes pa thams cad dag par bsam mo// de nas gzar bu gnyis blangs te lha'i zhal cung zad gdangs pa'i ljags hūm̐ las rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan pa la ram̐/ dgang blugs kyi gzar bu'i kha la'ang ram̐ bsam ste/ oṃ āḥkham̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā zhes lan gsum gyis bsngags te oṃ ag+na ye swā hā zhes pa lan bdun gyis bkang ba/ oṃ ag+na ye ā dī byā sogs dang*/ bdag gi sogs spel tshig sngar bzhin brjod/ de lta bu lan gsum gyis byon skyems dbul/ mchod pa rnams bsang sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las a las ye shes kyi ka pā la yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du hūm̐ zhu ba las byung ba'i lha rdzas las grub pa'i mchod yon sogs nas rol mo rnams dwangs shing thogs pa med pa nam mkha'i mtha' klas par gyur/

oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ āḥhūm̐ sogs nas shab+da āḥhūm̐ bar gyi byin gyis brlab/ oṃ bha ga wān ma hā kā ru ṇi ka sa ma ya badz+ra sa pa ri wā ra re re'i mgor sbyar ba'i ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ pā d+yaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūm̐ nas shab+da āḥhūm̐ bar dang*/ rdo rje dril bu gsil zhing ghaṇ+ḍe ra ṇi ta sogs brjod/ mtshan sngags kyi mthar oṃ āḥhūm̐ btags pas nang mchod dbul/ don yod rgyal po rdzogs sangs rgyas// bsam pa thams cad rdzogs mdzad pa// dngos nyid dag pa nyid las byung*// sna tshogs mkha' 'gror phyag 'tshal bstod// ces pas bstod/ bdag bskyed pha rgyud kyi phyogs yin na gsang 'dus ltar bstod/ de nas oṃ āḥkham̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā lan gsum re sngon du 'gro ba'i yam shing*/ mar/ til gsum po so so'i sngags kyis brgya rtsa re dbul ba spel tshig dang bcas pa gong dang 'dra'o// de nas gong gi oṃ āḥkham̐ sogs kyis til bsnyen pa'i kha skong la bcu cha'am/ sgrib sbyong spyir btang la gang mang 'bul dgos pas brgya rtsa re'i mtshams su spel tshig gong bzhin sbyar zhing mar dang yam shing yang skabs skabs su 'bul/ de'i tshe dmigs pa ni/ rang gi snying gar kam̐ yig nag po/ de las sdig sgrib nyes ltung thams cad du ba'am rlangs pa'i tshul gyis 'thon/ sna bug gnyis nas sdig pa rwa can gyi rnam pas mdun gyi til la thim par bsam/ slar yang de'i steng du a yig dkar po zhig bsams pa las bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs pa thim pas til zag med kyi bdud rtsir gyur/ de nyid lha'i zhal du phul bas sdig sgrib rnams zad par bsam zhing 'phro 'jog pa na snying ga'i kam̐ yig dngos gzhi yang phyir thon par bsam mo// bsdu ran pa na gong gi byon skyems ltar mar dgang blugs gsum gshegs skyems su dbul/ mchod pa rnams kha gsos la byin gyis brlab/ oṃ bha ga wān ma hā kā ru ṇi ka sa ma ya badz+ra sa pa ri wā ra re re'i mgor sbyar ba'i ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā nas/

shab+da'i bar dang rdo rje dril bu gsil zhing oṃ badz+ra ghaṇ+ḍe ra ṇi ta sogs brjod/ shes shing spro na dri med yid 'ong ma'am/ stong gsum 'di'am dang*/ lha yi mchod yon ma sogs kyi tshigs bcad bdag bskyed gang yin dang bstun kyang chog la/ phyi ma 'di gnyis la mtshan sngags oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta shrī sa ma ya badz+ra sogs brjod na legs/ spro na gos zung yang spyi ltar dbul/ mtshan sngags sam snying po gang rung gi mthar oṃ āḥhūm̐ btags pas nang mchod dbul/ rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas/ mnyam nyid mi g.yo mnyam nyid mchog gi chos nyid can// zhes sogs sangs rgyas mnyam sbyor gyi rgyud nas 'byung ba'i spyi bstod kyis bstod/ gtor ma nang mchod sogs kyis bran/ bdag bskyed gang yin gyi nang mchod ltar byin gyis brlab/ mtshan sngags kyi mthar oṃ a kā ro sogs btags pa lan gsum mam lngas dbul/ mtshan sngags lan gcig sngon du 'gro ba'i ar+ghaṃ sogs kyis phyi mchod dang*/ mtshan sngags kyi mthar oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis nang mchod dbul/ don yod rgyal po rdzogs sangs rgyas sogs kyis bstod/ thal mo sbyar te/ mgon po thugs rje chen po dang ldan pas bdag gi rgyud byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ bdag gi tshe 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig pa sgrib pa dam tshig dang sdom pa'i nyes ltung dri ma'i tshogs thams cad byang zhing dag par mdzad du gsol/ zhes gsol ba gdab/ spro na de'i tshab tu 'gyod sems kyi 'gyur ba drag po dang bcas pas mdun bskyed kyi steng dang bar snang thams cad du rtsa brgyud kyi bla ma yi dam dkon mchog gsum/ dpa' bo mkha' 'gro chos skyong thams cad mngon sum du dmigs la smre bshags kyi tshigs bcad ji ltar rigs pas gsol ba yid ches pa gdab par bya'o// de nas yig brgya lan gsum dang ma 'byor pa dang sogs/ oṃ/ khyed kyi sems can don kun mdzad sogs kyi mthar mtheb srin gyi se gol dang bcas oṃ badz+ra muḥ

ye shes pa rang bzhin gyi gnas su gshegs/ zhes dang*/ srin lag gis thal ba cung zad blangs nas rang gi dpral bar bskus te/ dam tshig pa rang la thim zhes brjod pa yan chad ni 'das pa'i me lha mchod pa'i cho ga'o// gsum pa rjes ni/ me lha lhag mas mchod pa sogs kyi ched du mar dgang blugs gang thab tu blug cing*/ oṃ badz+ra dz+wa la ram̐/ me lha zhal phyag gi rnam pa can du gyur ces pas gsal btab la/ oṃ bo dhi bṛk+ṣā ya sogs kyis bsreg rdzas kyi lhag ma bdun nam bcu gcig sogs ci 'byor pa dbul/ de nas dgang blugs te byon skyems ltar gshegs skyems lan gsum dbul/ me lha'i gtor ma chus bran la/ bsang sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las rin po che las grub pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du gtor ma kha dog dri ro nus pa phun sum tshogs pa bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ lan gsum dang bcas pas byin gyis brlab/ lag pa g.yas mchog sbyin dang bcas/ oṃ ag+na ye sa pa ri wā ra oṃ a kā ro sogs gsum mam lngas dbul/ oṃ āg+na ye sa pa ri wā ra re re'i mgor sbyar ba'i ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā sogs chu gnyis nyer spyod rol mo bcas kyi phyi mchod dang*/ oṃ ag+na ye sa pa ri wā ra oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis nang mchod dbul/ rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas/ 'jig rten dbang phyug sogs gong ltar gyis bstod/ drang srong chen po 'khor dang bcas pa khyed rnams kyis bdag gi tshe 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas sogs gong ltar gsol ba gdab bo// yi ge brgya pa lan gsum gyi rjes su/ ma 'byor pa dang sogs kyis nongs pa bzod par gsol/ dbyu gu rtse gsum pa'i phyag rgya phyir bskyed cing*/ bdag gi don dang gzhan gyi don// byin za khyod kyis bsgrubs kyis gshegs// ji bzhin dus su slar gshegs te// bdag gi dngos grub thams cad sgrubs// oṃ ag+na ye gats+tsha/ me lha rang bzhin gyi gnas su gshegs/

dam tshig pa rang la thim zhes brjod/ rang gi mig tu gti mug rdo rje ma sogs sam/ gnas rnams su zla ba'i dkyil 'khor sogs bdag bskyed kyi mjug sdud so so'i gzhung bzhin dang*/ bkra shis kyi tshigs bcad ci rigs brjod/ nyin grangs su byed na'ang sngar gyi thal ba'i steng du bud shing brtsigs pa ma gtogs thab bri ba sogs mi dgos shing*/ spros pa che na bsreg rdzas bcu gcig po spyi ltar phul kyang chog 'di'i phyag stabs 'khyud rgya can du thams cad mkhyen pa kun dga' grol mchog gis gsungs pa nyid 'thad che zhing*/ sngon gyi bris sku rnams la'ang 'khyud rgya kho nar snang ngo*// de dag gis ni spyi khyab tu 'jug bde'i cho ga snying por dril ba bstan zin to// gal te rnal 'byor pa rang gi lhag pa'i lha'i rnam 'gyur dang*/ cho ga la zhen ches pa dag gis don yod grub pa'i bsgom bzlas rang gzhung ltar byas kyang mi 'gal ba gsung sgros las 'byung zhing*/ mkhas pa 'ga' zhig gis bsgom bzlas gsang 'dus ltar mdzad 'dug pas/ 'das pa'i me lha kye rdo rje'i dbang chu nas 'byung ba ltar ram/ gur nas bshad pa'i zhal brgyad phyag bcu drug pa'am/ gsang 'dus ltar zhal gsum phyag drug pa'am/ ma rgyud spyi mthun gyi he ru ka ni dkyus kyi 'di nyid yin mod/ gzhan du bshad pa'i he ru ka gar stabs can phyag gnyis pa sogs su bskyed nas/ skye mched dang*/ gnas gsum byin rlabs/ go cha bgo ba sogs gong 'og gi cho ga thams cad rang rang gi gzhung bzhin nyams su blangs na'ang chog par mngon/ sngags ni thun mong ba 'di tsam gyis 'thus shing*/ mos na dkyil 'khor so so'i don yod grub pa'i sngags kyi byar rung ba ngag rgyun la yod pa'i dbang gis sbyin sreg kha cig tu gur gyi phu phu phu sogs bris 'dug shes byed kyi gtso bor dpal ldan zla ba grags pas sgron gsal du/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi gdon mi za ba ni don yod grub pa'o// de nyid dam tshig ste/

bya ba grub pa'i ye shes ni 'gro ba ma lus pa'i don rdzogs par byed pas na 'da' bar bya ba ma yin pas so// de nyid rdo rje ste/ de skad ces bya ba'i ting 'dzin gang yin pa de la snyoms par 'jug pa ste drang ba'i don to// gdon mi za ba'i dam tshig ni 'od gsal ba ste/ mtshan ma med pa'i 'bras bu ster bas so// de nyid rdo rje ste/ de la dmigs pa ni nges pa'i don to// nyon mongs pa phrag dog rnam par sbyong ba nyid dang*/ nyon mongs pas dam tshig nyams pa la sogs pa'i nyes pa sel bar byed pa'i don gyi rigs ni dam tshig dgug pa'i rigs te drang ba'i don to// dam tshig ni khams phra ba ste/ des thabs kyi ye shes bkug nas mchog tu dga' ba bskyed pas yongs su sbyong ba'i rigs ni dam tshig dgug pa'i rigs te nges pa'i don to// zhes sogs kyi dam tshig rdo rje ste zhes pa don yod grub pa'i mtshan gyi bye brag tu gsungs shing*/ rgyud gzhan du rta mchog la sogs pas bstan/ gang du mtshan don ma bshad pa der/ rjod byed rgya che ba'i rgyud dang rgyud 'grel 'di dang 'di lta bu dag las len pa las 'os ci yod/ gzhan yang yig rnying nges gsal med pa'i sbyin sreg dgos pa shar na cho ga bar ma 'di tsam gyis sgrub rung ba mkhas pa'i srol yin pas rdo rje sems dpa'i sgom bzlas la brten nas sbyin sreg byed na'ang tshul 'di nyid lha sngags spos pas chog go /de ltar rnam gzhag spyi dang mi 'gal zhing*// skabs don tshang ba'i cho ga 'di spel bas// chos rab 'byed pa'i mtshan nyid can 'dzin pa'i/

pradz+nyā dhṛka ces don grub kyi mtshan/ /byang chub 'gro ba kun gyis rtogs gyur cig /ces bcom ldan 'das dam tshig rdo rje'i sbyin sreg gi cho ga 'od gsal rdo rje'i me long zhes bya ba 'di ni yi ge rnying pa khungs ldan zhig ma rnyed kyang*/ rnam gzhag spyi dang mthun zhing*/ skabs don tshang ba'i tshul du dge sbyong wā gin+d+ra su sid+dhis e wam̐ chos ldan du rang gi 'don tho tsam du bsgrigs pa la/ slar yang lhun grub steng du bstan bcos kyi lugs su bsdebs pa'o// //dge'o// // ༈ bal yul mchod rten rin po che bya rung kha shor gyi nye 'gram rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa glog klad dpar khang las/ bder gshegs 7skyabs rje bco brgyad khri chen rdo rje 'chang mchog gi thugs dgongs rdzogs ched/ skyabs 'og pa tshar grwa gu rus glog klad phyag deb ched 'grem spel zhus pa'i dge 'bras sangs rgyas zhing du bsngo'o// //
